name: Takahata Rumi
source:
The president of [url=http://vndb.org/c1482]Eiji[/url]'s class. A bright, high-spirited and popular girl, her father is a newly rich self-made man and her family is tremendously wealthy. Thanks to her personality this upper class "princess" status of hers doesn't particularly show, though. Born as a futanari, she got over her dislike for her body at an early age and came to be curious about all things sexual. With Natsuki as a partner she's been researching her sexuality almost nightly in the school infirmary. While already fully sexually experienced, she is constantly in search of further stimulus and pleasure. While Rumi is a naturally effervescent and outspoken co-ed, she can at times be particularly authoritative, sadistic and intolerant, especially during group activities.

[From [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/GC035]J-List[/url] and [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cat_Girl_Alliance]Wikipedia[/url]]
